title: elymus repens subsp. atlantis
intro: Elymus repens subsp. atlantis, commonly known as Atlantic couch grass, is a subspecies of the perennial grass Elymus repens. It is known for its potential medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The health benefits of Atlantic couch grass include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
